fact_text: Saudi Arabia offered to take a 15% stake in the Reko Diq gold and copper project in Balochistan, a proposal the Pakistan cabinet was to consider.

fact_text: Media reports put the amount discussed for the Reko Diq stake at about USD 5 billion.

fact_text: A timeline set around 2027 for Reko Diq commercial production has slipped, and production is not expected before 2028 because of repeated delays.

fact_text: The analyst said OGDC and PPL trade at low price-to-book and forward price-to-earnings multiples, which he called cheap relative to their book value.

fact_text: The analyst said PPL's dividend has risen while OGDC's has grown less, because slower circular debt build-up on PPL's receivables improved its cash flow.

fact_text: Higher gas prices set for the SSGC and SNGPL distribution systems pass part of the benefit upstream to producers such as PPL, the analyst said.

fact_text: The analyst noted incoming companies had already performed strongly while outgoing companies had weak share prices, and that index changes follow market capitalisation and performance.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Reko Diq Case  | New Companies Joining KSE 100 Index | Why PSX Is Unaffected by Interest Rate Cuts' (YouTube, 2024-09-21)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan's IMF matters were moving toward the IMF board, which could bring an inflow of about USD 7 billion in loans.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Reko Diq Case  | New Companies Joining KSE 100 Index | Why PSX Is Unaffected by Interest Rate Cuts' (YouTube, 2024-09-21)

fact_text: The analyst said proposed amendments in the National Assembly and an extension issue unsettled the system, which held back KSE-100 performance.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Reko Diq Case  | New Companies Joining KSE 100 Index | Why PSX Is Unaffected by Interest Rate Cuts' (YouTube, 2024-09-21)

fact_text: A rate cut lowers a company's finance charges, which gives an incremental boost to EPS for companies carrying heavy interest-bearing debt.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Reko Diq Case  | New Companies Joining KSE 100 Index | Why PSX Is Unaffected by Interest Rate Cuts' (YouTube, 2024-09-21)

fact_text: The analyst said the KSE-100 had not yet shown the full benefit of the rate cut, because the lower interest cost reaches company earnings only with a lag.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Reko Diq Case  | New Companies Joining KSE 100 Index | Why PSX Is Unaffected by Interest Rate Cuts' (YouTube, 2024-09-21)

fact_text: The analyst expected DG Khan Cement to be among the biggest beneficiaries of a rate cut because it carries large bank loans.

fact_text: The analyst said Best Way Cement also carries large loans and would gain from a rate cut.
